name: KV-Ground 8B (BaseGuiOwl1.5 0315)
notes: The Hub repository holds four safetensors shards in the Qwen3-VL architecture inherited from its base. The card, by Kingsware and Vocaela AI, declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for this checkpoint (non-commercial, share-alike). The base model mPLUG/GUI-Owl-1.5-8B-Instruct is not an active catalog record, so no variant relation is recorded. Card scores (73.2 on ScreenSpot-Pro without zoom-in, 80.5 with it) are publisher measurements with the publisher's own prompt setup; the card has no training-data release. Smaller 4B siblings from the same publisher are separate Hub repositories.
summary: GUI-grounding checkpoint post-trained from GUI-Owl-1.5-8B-Instruct with SFT and GRPO on cleaned and synthesized high-resolution data, aimed at locating elements in large screenshots.
